title: Slack API in 2026: Webhooks, chat.postMessage, Limits
snippet:

PriceNo fee to call the API. Free workspaces can install up to 10 apps
WebhooksOne URL per channel, picked by the person installing your app. The URL is the credential
Bot postingchat.postMessage with chat:write; chat:write.public for public channels the bot isn't in
Messagetext up to 4,000 characters for best results, truncated at 40,000. Up to 50 blocks, 3,000 characters per section
ImagesImage blocks load a public URL; png, jpg, jpeg and gif only
Rate limitAbout 1 message a second per channel, with short bursts; 429 with Retry-After
Schedulingchat.scheduleMessage, up to 120 days ahead, 30 per 5 minutes per channel
DistributionAny workspace can install an unlisted app, but Slack's terms send commercial apps to its Marketplace

## Is the Slack API free?
Calling Slack's API has no fee, and Slack doesn't charge for a Marketplace listing. Free workspaces can install up to 10 apps and see 90 days of messages.
What it costs is approval: unlisted apps get a warning on install, slower reading APIs, and, if you sell them, Slack's terms point to the Marketplace review.
Through Breakreach, each connected channel counts as one account: $5 a month each up to 20, $3 up to 100, then $2.

title: Slack Pricing in 2026: Pro vs Business+, Fair Billing, and the Limits on AI Workflows
snippet:
As of October 11, 2026, Slack Pro costs $7.25 per user a month billed annually ($8.75 monthly), Business+ costs $15 ($18 monthly) and Enterprise+ is listed at $45 billed annually, and Slack bills only active members. AI steps in Workflow Builder start on Business+, and Slack caps a message-triggered AI step at 10 runs an hour per workflow.

**As of October 11, 2026, Slack Pro costs $7.25 per user a month billed annually or $8.75 billed monthly, Business+ costs $15 billed annually or $18 monthly, and Enterprise+ is listed at $45 per user a month billed annually. The Free plan keeps 90 days of message history and allows up to 10 apps. Slack only bills members who are actively using it, and the AI steps that make Slack workflows useful start on Business+, not Pro.**

| | Free | Pro | Business+ | Enterprise+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per user, billed annually | $0 | $7.25 | $15 | $45 |
| Per user, billed monthly | $0 | $8.75 | $18 | Contact sales |
| Message and file history | 90 days | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| App integrations | 10 | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Huddles and Slack Connect | 1:1 only | Group | Group | Group |
| Workflow Builder | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Conditional branching in workflows | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| AI steps and AI workflow generation | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Slackbot personal AI agent, AI search | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Thread and channel summaries, huddle notes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Single sign-on | No | OAuth with Google | SAML | Multi-SAML |
Pro and Business+ also include custom workflow steps (developer-built steps that call your own systems), deployment of custom functions on Slack's infrastructure at no extra cost, and AI assistant apps that embed third-party agents. Business+ adds exports of all messages, including private channels and DMs, data residency and SCIM provisioning. Enterprise+ adds enterprise search across connected apps, multiple workspaces, audit logs, legal holds, HIPAA support and data loss prevention.

Every Slack plan gets the same API rate limit tiers, so paying more does not buy API speed. The limits a small business build is most likely to meet:
| Where it applies | Documented limit |
|---|---|
| Workflow webhook triggers (forms, outside apps starting a workflow) | 10 per minute |
| Workflow event triggers | 10,000 per hour |
| AI Generate step | 100 per day per workflow; 10 per hour if message-triggered |
